answer: A hostile operator running 125 aliases as a result needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in crystal, expire in river, and raven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3264 identities would post 1200 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
